valid_order_finish.name: valid_order_finish
valid_order_finish.value: ("order_ticket"."finished_at" IS NULL AND "order_ticket"."finished_by" IS NULL AND "order_ticket"."finished_by_name" IS NULL AND "order_ticket"."finished_session_id" IS NULL) OR ("order_ticket"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL AND "order_ticket"."finished_at">="order_ticket"."received_at" AND "order_ticket"."finished_by" IS NOT NULL AND "order_ticket"."finished_by_name" IS NOT NULL AND "order_ticket"."finished_session_id" IS NOT NULL)

sale_status_timestamps.name: sale_status_timestamps
sale_status_timestamps.value: ("sale"."status" IN ('pending','cancelled') AND "sale"."attested_at" IS NULL AND "sale"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("sale"."status"='paid' AND "sale"."attested_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sale"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("sale"."status"='completed' AND "sale"."attested_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sale"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sale"."completed_at" >= "sale"."attested_at")

sheets_job_source.name: sheets_job_source
sheets_job_source.value: ("sheets_sync_job"."kind"='sale' AND "sheets_sync_job"."source_id"="sheets_sync_job"."sale_id" AND "sheets_sync_job"."sale_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sheets_sync_job"."attendance_id" IS NULL) OR ("sheets_sync_job"."kind"='attendance' AND "sheets_sync_job"."source_id"="sheets_sync_job"."attendance_id" AND "sheets_sync_job"."attendance_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sheets_sync_job"."sale_id" IS NULL)

stock_item_valid.name: stock_item_valid
stock_item_valid.value: length(btrim("stock_item"."name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND "stock_item"."unit" IN ('pcs','pack') AND "stock_item"."low_threshold" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000 AND "stock_item"."revision">0 AND "stock_item"."balance" BETWEEN -9000000000000 AND 9000000000000

stock_movement_valid.name: stock_movement_valid
stock_movement_valid.value: "stock_movement"."kind" IN ('opening','restock','adjust','sale') AND "stock_movement"."delta" BETWEEN -9000000000000 AND 9000000000000 AND "stock_movement"."balance_after" BETWEEN -9000000000000 AND 9000000000000 AND length("stock_movement"."reason")<=200 AND (("stock_movement"."kind"='sale' AND "stock_movement"."sale_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movement"."operation_id" IS NULL AND "stock_movement"."delta"<0 AND "stock_movement"."sale_reference" IS NOT NULL) OR ("stock_movement"."kind"<>'sale' AND "stock_movement"."sale_id" IS NULL AND "stock_movement"."operation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movement"."sale_reference" IS NULL))

stock_usage_valid.name: stock_usage_valid
stock_usage_valid.value: "stock_usage"."per_unit" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000 AND "stock_usage"."quantity" BETWEEN 1 AND 99000000 AND "stock_usage"."recipe_revision">0
